title: Haier — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Haier.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Smart Value Leader." Haier is the worlds largest appliance company by volume. In North America, the Haier brand covers compact and mid-range appliances — wine coolers, portable washers, and small refrigeration. GE Appliances, Fisher & Paykel, and Candy are all Haier-owned.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Compact appliance needs. Wine coolers and beverage storage. Budget-conscious buyers.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Haier:

• Worlds largest appliance company — massive R&D and manufacturing scale

• Compact and specialty appliance leader

• Owns GE Appliances and Fisher & Paykel — proven quality capability

• Wine coolers and beverage centers at competitive prices

• Growing retail presence across North America
